title: ds007 - EU Power of Attorney (EU PoA) – SD-JWT VC payload
description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of an EU PoA as defined in the EU PoA Rulebook (rb-eu-poa, Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing. The attestation is a single flat object; selective disclosure per claim is specified in the rulebook, not here.

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type. For the EU PoA this is 'uri:eu.eudi.eu-poa.1'.

attestation_legal_category.description: Legal category of the attestation as defined by eIDAS 2.

issuing_authority.description: Name of the administrative authority that issued the EU PoA, or the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the Member State if there is no separate authority entitled to issue the EU PoA.

issuing_country.description: Alpha-2 country code, as specified in ISO 3166-1, of the country or territory of the provider of the attestation.

date_of_execution.description: Date the PoA was executed (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD). Equal to or earlier than validity_period_valid_from (IR-02).

euid_reference.description: EUID reference of the company on whose behalf the PoA is granted.

principal_full_name.description: Legal full name of the principal, the natural person who grants the PoA on behalf of the company.

principal_date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the principal (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

principal_identification_document_kind.description: Type of identification document presented by the principal. See code list in rulebook section 2.8.

principal_identification_document_number.description: Identification document number of the principal.

principal_place_of_birth.description: Place of birth of the principal.

principal_full_address.description: Residential address of the principal, as one string.

company_statutory_full_name.description: Registered legal name of the company.

company_business_register_name.description: Name of the business register in which the company is registered.

company_kind_of_legal_entity.description: Legal form of the company (e.g. B.V., GmbH, SARL, SA).

company_jurisdiction.description: Country of incorporation, alpha-2 country code as specified in ISO 3166-1.

company_registered_office.description: Registered office address of the company, as one string.

attorney_full_name.description: Legal full name of the attorney (delegate).

attorney_date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the attorney (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

attorney_identification_document_kind.description: Type of identification document presented by the attorney. See code list in rulebook section 2.8.

attorney_identification_document_number.description: Identification document number of the attorney.

attorney_place_of_birth.description: Place of birth of the attorney.

attorney_full_address.description: Residential address of the attorney, as one string.

scope_of_representation_powers.description: The powers granted to the attorney, taken from the six powers listed in rulebook section 2.8. If scope_of_representation_power_of_substitution is 'limited', the limitation details are added to this array as well (IR-04); otherwise only the six listed powers are allowed.
examples: Registration and closure of branches of the Company

scope_of_representation_power_of_substit.description: Whether the attorney may delegate the granted powers to a third party. If 'limited', the limitation details are included in scope_of_representation_powers (IR-04).

validity_period_valid_from.description: Start date of validity of the PoA (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

validity_period_valid_until.description: End date of validity of the PoA (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD). Later than validity_period_valid_from (IR-01).

applicable_law_jurisdiction.description: Governing Member State law, alpha-2 country code as specified in ISO 3166-1.

signing_place.description: Place where the PoA was signed.

signing_date.description: Date the PoA was signed (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

trust_anchor.description: URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor to be used for verifying the EU PoA can be found or looked up.

status.description: Credential status following SD-JWT VC Status List. Required when the validity period of the attestation exceeds 24 hours (rulebook section 2.6, location_status).

type.description: Status mechanism type. For SD-JWT VC Status List this SHALL be 'status-list'.

status_list_credential.description: URI of the Status List Credential that contains the bitstring indicating status.

status_list_index.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring for this credential.

status_purpose.description: Purpose of the status entry. For the EU PoA this is 'revocation'.

cnf.description: Key binding confirmation per SD-JWT VC. The EU PoA is bound to the wallet of the holder.

jwk.description: Public key bound to the holder wallet.

iss.description: Issuer identifier (URL or DID) of the EU PoA provider, RFC 7519.

sub.description: Subject identifier of the holder (e.g. DID).

exp.description: Expiry (epoch seconds), RFC 7519. Carries the expiry_date metadata of rulebook section 2.5.

enum: Changes to the instrument of constitution of companies and the statutes if contained in a separate instrument
Registration and closure of branches of the Company
All legal transactions regarding cross-border conversions involving the Company
All legal transactions regarding cross border mergers involving the Company
All legal transactions regarding cross border divisions involving the Company
